#define first fi
#define second se

int total_n, total_m, modulus, C[MAX][MAX];
Pair dp_table[MAX][MAX];

int add_mod(int a, int b) {
    return a + b >= modulus ? a + b - modulus : a + b;
}

Pair operator+(const Pair &a, const Pair &b) {
    return make_pair(add_mod(a.fi, b.fi), add_mod(a.se, b.se));
}

Pair operator*(const Pair &a, const Pair &b) {
    long long fi_part = 1LL * a.fi * b.fi % modulus;
    long long se_part = (1LL * a.fi * b.se + 1LL * a.se * b.fi) % modulus;
    return make_pair((int)fi_part, (int)se_part);
}

int sum_range(int left, int right) {
    return (left + right) * (right - left + 1) / 2;
}

    freopen("a.out", "w", stdout);
